findings.quote: AI offers extraordinary potential, but its capability is advancing faster than our appreciation of its risks.
findings.rationale: Discusses AI loss of control, misuse and social disruption risks alongside benefits.

findings.quote: We need rigorous testing and evaluation before deployment. We need clear limits on what autonomous systems can do. and mechanisms to intervene when they behave in ways we do not intend.
findings.rationale: Calls for AI safeguards, human control and international coordination.

findings.quote: We must explore all options, including the idea of a UN framework convention on AI safeguards.
findings.rationale: Proposes international AI safeguards and institutions, building on existing UN AI bodies.

findings.quote: We will continue to contribute through platforms such as the digital pillar for the Forum of Small States and by making our governance frameworks and testing tools available to all.
findings.rationale: Continues the preceding AI governance discussion with commitments to share frameworks and testing tools.
